spec.description: SolarEdge inverter health: status, AC output and DC input metrics from the SolarEdge exporter.

spec.title: AC Voltage
spec.description: Phase-to-neutral AC output voltage per phase (A, B, C), scaled by the SunSpec scale factor.

spec.title: AC Voltage between phases
spec.description: Phase-to-phase AC output voltage (AB, BC, CA).

spec.title: AC Active Power
spec.description: Real AC power delivered by the inverter, in watts.

spec.title: AC Apparent Power
spec.description: Apparent AC power (VA): combined real and reactive power.

spec.title: AC Reactive Power
spec.description: Reactive AC power (VAr) exchanged with the grid.

spec.title: Inverter status
spec.description: Current inverter operating state (e.g. producing, sleeping, fault).

4.text: Inverter is ON and producing power

spec.title: AC Current
spec.description: Total and per-phase AC output current, in amps.

spec.title: AC Frequency
spec.description: AC output frequency; should track grid frequency.

spec.title: AC Power Factor
spec.description: AC power factor: ratio of real to apparent power.

spec.title: DC Power
spec.description: DC input power from the PV array, in watts.

spec.title: DC Voltage
spec.description: DC input voltage from the PV array.

spec.title: DC Current
spec.description: DC input current from the PV array, in amps.

spec.title: Heatsink Temperature (${temp_unit:text})
spec.description: Inverter heatsink temperature; sustained high values may trigger derating.

spec.title: Energy in selected timeframe
spec.description: AC energy produced within the selected dashboard time range ($__range).

spec.title: Grid configuration
spec.description: Inverter grid configuration derived from the SunSpec device ID (single, split or three phase).

spec.title: Lifetime AC energy produced
spec.description: Total AC energy produced over the inverter's lifetime.

spec.title: Actual vs expected AC power
spec.description: Actual AC power from the selected inverters against expected AC power for the whole site (Site_Expected_AC_Power_W). Expected is for the full array, so compare with all inverters selected.

spec.title: Performance ratio
spec.description: Actual divided by expected, shown only while the sun is up and plane-of-array irradiance is above 50 W/m2. Capped at 150%. Expected is for the whole site, so the ratio is only meaningful with all inverters selected.

spec.title: Irradiance at site
spec.description: Global tilted (plane-of-array) irradiance at the configured PV tilt and azimuth, and global horizontal irradiance, from Open-Meteo.

spec.title: Site location
spec.description: Marker for the site location used to estimate expected power. The tooltip shows the city and how the location was found.

spec.title: Location source
spec.description: How the site location was found: a public IP lookup, or coordinates set for this site.

spec.title: Data age
spec.description: How long since the last irradiance reading and the last location check. Irradiance is read about every 15 minutes. The location is checked about once a day. A number that keeps climbing well past that means the update has stopped.

spec.title: PV assumptions
spec.description: Tilt, compass direction, array size, and performance ratio used to estimate expected AC power.

spec.title: SolarEdge Exporter
